svg.text: Top view, USB end down. The Teensy is a DMA master on the 68030 bus, driving the DS1250.
Address, data, /AS, /WE and FC pins are tri-stated except while the Teensy owns the bus.
/BR and /BGACK are always driven; /BG is an input; /RESET is wired-OR (open drain). PD6 (A6) also carries the on-board LED.
Interior pads are drawn at true spacing (except ALE, moved clear of PA7's label); the edge rows are spread out for labels.
